rubric_revision_note: Thresholds pre-registered before candidate execution. Outcome keys derive from fixture behavior and explicit user constraints. Independent-role success must also be checked against runtime traces; narration alone cannot pass. Baseline and with-skill runtime capability differences must be disclosed. After iteration 6 exposed missing nested artifacts in launch grading, added explicit plan/state paths for both launch variants. No criterion or threshold changed; rerun both variants with the same artifact selection. Added a dedicated interrupted-state fixture before running it, to distinguish real checkpoint recovery from the existing stale-report case. Runtime collaboration counts and persisted child identities are now supplied by the runner to graders; older execution cases are regraded with this captured evidence, without changing criteria or thresholds. Full MEA cases need --timeout-ms 1200000 on this host. After nested audit reports were omitted by top-level artifact selection, execution prompts now request a root verification-evidence.md export. Archived executions are regraded with existing nested plan/state/audit text supplied directly by the harness under the same bounded selection policy for both variants; no task result is rewritten. This is evidence transport repair, not a new candidate execution.
